trash.description: What you delete stays here: it goes back to its place with everything that left with it.
trash.emptyState: The trash is empty. What you delete stays here until you decide.
trash.purgeAsk: Delete “{name}” forever? It cannot be recovered.
trash.purgeAskWith: Delete “{name}” forever, {with}? It cannot be recovered.
trash.purgeAskChoices: Delete “{name}” forever, together with the choice that leads here from another scene? It cannot be recovered. | Delete “{name}” forever, together with the {n} choices that lead here from other scenes? They cannot be recovered.
trash.purgeAskWithChoices: Delete “{name}” forever, {with}, and the choice that leads here from another scene? It cannot be recovered. | Delete “{name}” forever, {with}, and the {n} choices that lead here from other scenes? They cannot be recovered.
trash.restoredIn: It is now in the chapter “{name}”.
trash.restoreSceneFirst: Restore the scene “{name}” first: the revision comes back with it.
trash.emptyAsk: Delete the only item in the trash forever? It cannot be recovered. | Delete the {n} items in the trash forever? They cannot be recovered.
trash.emptyChoices: This also deletes the choice of another scene that leads to a scene in the trash. | This also deletes the {n} choices of other scenes that lead to scenes in the trash.
trash.emptied: Trash emptied: {n} item deleted forever | Trash emptied: {n} items deleted forever
